notes.learning: From 'ìmọ̀' (knowledge) + 'ìṣirò' (calculation/computation). Refers to the abstract science of numbers, quantity, and space.

examples: Ìmọ̀ ìṣirò ṣe pàtàkì fún iṣẹ́ ẹ̀rọ kọ̀mpútà. (Mathematics is important for computer science)
Ó ń kọ́ àwọn ọmọ ilé ẹ̀kọ́ ní ìmọ̀ ìṣirò. (He teaches mathematics to students)
data.subject: Mathematics
